profile.name: Feetech 智能舵机总线
profile.description: 由 Feetech 总线型智能舵机及其串行通信链路组成的多电机控制系统，可连接多个机器人关节或夹爪执行器。它常用于机械臂、夹爪等实验室机器人平台，以读取位置等状态并下发目标位置等控制命令。
profile.description_en: A multi-actuator control system built around Feetech bus-connected smart servos and their serial communication bus. It is commonly used in laboratory robotic platforms such as robot arms and grippers to read status such as position and send control commands such as target position.

registry.name: Feetech RC Model Feetech Motors Bus
registry.description: Feetech Motors BUS是由Feetech RC Model生产的机械臂，主要功能包括写入数据、参数配置、复位、捕获、日志记录、设备连接。支持Signal, Slot, apply calibration等操作。
